description: This file contains common API functions for arithmetic operations, saturation, rounding, and utility functions used in OpenMAX DL, specifically for H.264 decoding support on ARM architecture.

methods.name: armRoundFloatToS16
methods.description: Converts a double precision float to a 16-bit signed integer with rounding.

methods.name: armRoundFloatToS32
methods.description: Converts a double precision float to a 32-bit signed integer with rounding.

methods.name: armSatRoundFloatToS16
methods.description: Converts a double precision float to a 16-bit signed integer with saturation and rounding.

methods.name: armSatRoundFloatToS32
methods.description: Converts a double precision float to a 32-bit signed integer with saturation and rounding.

methods.name: armSatRoundFloatToU16
methods.description: Converts a double precision float to a 16-bit unsigned integer with saturation and rounding.

methods.name: armSatRoundFloatToU32
methods.description: Converts a double precision float to a 32-bit unsigned integer with saturation and rounding.

methods.name: armRoundFloatToS64
methods.description: Converts a double precision float to a 64-bit signed integer with rounding.

methods.name: armSignCheck
methods.description: Checks the sign of a 16-bit signed integer, returning 1, 0, or -1.

methods.name: armClip
methods.description: Clips an integer value between specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: armClip_F32
methods.description: Clips a float value between specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: armShiftSat_F32
methods.description: Divides a float by 2^shift, saturates the result within unsigned range for satBits.

methods.name: armSwapElem
methods.description: Swaps two elements of arbitrary size at given memory locations.

methods.name: armMedianOf3
methods.description: Finds the median of three integers.

methods.name: armLogSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimum number of bits needed to represent a positive value.

methods.name: armSatAdd_S32
methods.description: Performs saturated addition of two 32-bit signed integers.

methods.name: armSatAdd_S64
methods.description: Performs saturated addition of two 64-bit signed integers.

methods.name: armSatSub_S32
methods.description: Performs saturated subtraction of two 32-bit signed integers.

methods.name: armSatMac_S32
methods.description: Performs saturated multiply-accumulate on 16-bit values into a 32-bit result.

methods.name: armSatMac_S16S32_S32
methods.description: Performs saturated MAC operation with 32-bit accumulator, 32-bit delay element, and 16-bit filter tap.

methods.name: armSatRoundRightShift_S32_S16
methods.description: Performs rounded right shift on 32-bit int, saturating to 16-bit range.

methods.name: armSatRoundLeftShift_S32
methods.description: Performs saturating left shift or rounded right shift if shift is negative.

methods.name: armSatRoundLeftShift_S64
methods.description: Performs saturating left shift or rounded right shift on 64-bit int.

methods.name: armSatMulS16S32_S32
methods.description: Multiplies a 16-bit signed int with a 32-bit signed int, returning a 32-bit result.

methods.name: armSatMulS32S32_S32
methods.description: Multiplies two 32-bit signed ints, returning a 32-bit result with saturation.

methods.name: armIntDivAwayFromZero
methods.description: Performs integer division with rounding away from zero.
